root_motion: None. Game controller supplies horizontal and vertical travel. Jump height in previews is simulated controller motion, not Action root keys.
jump_preview_note: Temporary render-only Actions supply jump height and forward travel for moving transitions. All gameplay root keys remain stationary.

rigid_frame_repair.cause: Solid frame meshes had vertices assigned to both thigh and shin bones, causing the frames to deform through the front thigh armor.

weapon_elevation.note: Aiming contribution only; torso locomotion lean is not globally clamped. Main bore has existing neutral ~2 degree upward cant. Target angles are offsets from neutral. Runtime target solver must compensate actual hull orientation.

weapon_elevation_verification.scope: All-frame root and angle checks; 29 sampled poses per clip for moving pod shells/covers/barrels and main barrel versus hull, stowage, hip and thigh armor. Embedded cannon trunnion/mantlet mating surfaces excluded; not an exhaustive every-object collision test.
